07b2fdd2-243f-40f6-94f8-74f7058834b8.name: Council's Judgment
rules: Will of the council — Starting with you, each player votes for a nonland permanent you don't control. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.

8c58f9f6-6f0c-493e-afb3-229f7e8fec16.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
